name: spec
description: Spec pipeline v7 — a small code program run by a trusted engineer, verified by executed evidence. Full lifecycle: greenfield genesis (/spec:genesis, including an in-driver taste-funnel explore state and design-ratification state) → roadmap briefs → /spec:sketch → /spec:plan → optional /spec:design (mock-bound, deterministic fidelity gates) → /spec:build (direct Sonnet worker dispatch per layer wave, executed red-check) → /spec:review (spec-review-driver.js stepped, driver-stepped: deterministic legs via review-legs.js + ONE fresh-context reviewer whose non-soft findings carry executed repros; verdict derived by verdict.js) → /spec:release, plus /spec:atlas, /spec:status, /spec:doctor, /spec:enforce, /spec:escape, /spec:replay. Changelog (last 3): 7.40.2 — design becomes a driver state (specs/20260827/03-genesis-design-state.md): the design lock folds into genesis-driver.js as a new `DESIGN` state between `ROADMAP` and `HANDOFF`, mark-driven — `doctrine-drafted` (a one-page `docs/design/doctrine.md`, `## Dissents` carrying every rejected direction) → `tokens-landed` (visual archetypes only: the winner's `tokens.css` ratified verbatim, an approved matrix-expanded mock passing `design-atlas.js check --matrix`, `design/components.json` present) → `rules-locked` (`design-rules.json` category/grounding enums valid, `components-check.js` green). `backend-api`/`data-ml` are written `design: skipped`; non-visual archetypes skip the tokens mark. Once `rules-locked` is accepted the driver prunes the losing `design/explore/` candidates, the gallery, the throwaway sketch, and the authored-tokens snapshot — an act of the accepted mark, never a step a session could forget. `/spec:genesis-design` is deleted: its command file, its `shared-for` map entry (`/spec:genesis` now serves § Design Authoring Contracts directly), its `entrypoints.json` rows, and its arm in `genesis-state-gate.sh`'s `case` lists (and the now-callerless `require_scaffold` helper) are all gone — a stray `/spec:genesis-design` prompt now falls through the hook untouched, and the hook gates only `/spec:init` on a partial canon. HANDOFF always points at `/spec:init` next. A repo-wide sweep (`tests/consistency/genesis-doctrine.test.js`) pins that no live surface still names the retired command. 7.40.1 — explore folds into the driver (specs/20260827/02-genesis-explore-state.md): the taste funnel's Round 0 (fresh UX research, position briefs, starter tokens, Sonnet-built style tiles, the deterministic check, the gallery, the cull to two) becomes driver states between `MENUS` and `FINALISTS` — `research-done` → `positions-authored` → `tiles-built` → `tiles-culled` — entered for visual archetypes (`web-app`, `mobile-app`, `realtime-trading`, `desktop-app`) and written `skipped` for every other archetype. A design the user already made (a Claude Design export or any local mock bundle) now enters as an **external candidate** (`--mark external --file <dir>`) and skips the funnel entirely — no research brief owed, no `dc-extract`. The two culled positions (or the external candidate) render inside each racing finalist's own scaffold and component library as the tournament's `style-tile` probe task, so the user judges stack and look together in one gallery; `--mark picked` records `design-pick.json`'s `winner` alongside `tournament.winner`. Round-1 interactive prototypes and persona walkthroughs are retired — the booted finalist is now the interactive candidate. `/spec:genesis-explore` is deleted: its command file, its `shared-for` map entry (`/spec:genesis` now serves § Design Canon directly), its `entrypoints.json` rows, and its arm in `genesis-state-gate.sh`'s `case` lists are all gone — a stray `/spec:genesis-explore` prompt now falls through the hook untouched. A repo-wide sweep (`tests/consistency/genesis-doctrine.test.js`) pins that no live surface still names the retired command. 7.40.0 — the tournament of scaffolds (specs/20260827/01-genesis-tournament.md): genesis-driver.js gains four states between MENUS and DECIDE for tournament archetypes (`web-app`, `realtime-trading`, `backend-api`, `mobile-app`, `desktop-app`) — `FINALISTS` (the session names 2–3 finalist stack combinations to race, printing a go/no-go cost line before any spend), `RACE` (driver-only: scaffolds, gates, and boots each finalist for real into `.claude/genesis/tournament/finalists/<name>/` through `smoke.sh`'s existing boot contract), `PROBE` (the session builds one probe slice per finalist with Sonnet workers under a two-retry cap per task, recording harness-reported tokens, never estimated), and `PICK` (the driver re-runs gate + boot post-probe and writes `tournament/benchmark.json`/`.md` + `gallery.html` — executed evidence informs the user's pick, it never makes it). Every other archetype still derives `MENUS → DECIDE` directly and writes no `tournament/` directory. `--mark menus-done` now additionally requires a `- archetype: <key>` line in the brief's `## Picks` (one of the eight registry keys) and stores `status.archetype`. At `decided`, the winner is re-scaffolded clean into the project root — the probe slice was built under retry caps with no spec and no review and must never become the foundation — and the raced copies (`tournament/finalists/`, `tournament/logs/`) are deleted once an ADR cites `tournament/benchmark.md` as evidence. Every driver state now prints its own `Doctrine: spec/doctrine/genesis.md § Genesis: …` pointer; `/spec:genesis`'s `## Per-state judgment pointers` section is deleted, since the choreography it restated now has one binding home instead of two.
